Packaging Meat - 2-Shift - Oudenaarde  

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

We are looking for Meat Production Workers for a growing food company!

The company processes ham and packages it for various supermarket chains.

The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

PROFIEL

What are your responsibilities?

• As a packer, you will slice and package ham
• Work in cold/cool temperatures
• You will work in the Oudenaarde area
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

AANBOD

What do we offer you?

• We offer competitive and fair compensation, and there is no mandatory collective leave.
• You can schedule your time off as you wish.
• A quick start is possible.
• You’ll work on a weekly contract basis, and after a successful temporary assignment, you’ll be offered a permanent contract.

Operator / Bender - Zwevegem

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

Do you have a passion for technology and are you looking for a challenging job with responsibility?
Become a bending machine operator in an innovative production environment! You'll bend pipes of various sizes, cut them to length where needed, and remove burrs. The work can be physically demanding, especially with larger pipes. Experience in the metal industry is a strong plus.

What are you tasks?

• 
Operate and set up the bending machine to ensure precise pipe shaping.

• 
Monitor the process and intervene in case of malfunctions to guarantee a perfect end product.

• 
2-shift system!

Dutch and/or English language skills are required.

PROFIEL

Your profile:

• 
You have technical knowledge or experience in a similar role.

• 
Accuracy and attention to detail are your strong suits.

• 
You are eager to learn and interested in automation and production processes.

• 
You can work independently, but also thrive in a team environment.

• 
Safety and quality are always your top priorities.

AANBOD

Our offer:

• 
A stable job in an innovative production environment.

• 
Competitive salary with extra benefits – salary + 12.50% shift bonus.

• 
Internal training and opportunities for growth.

• 
Work in a dynamic team with a positive and supportive atmosphere.

STUDIEVEREISTEN
Geen specifieke studievereisten

Welder - Semi-Automatic - Lokeren 

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

For a family-run metal workshop specializing in the production of steel doors and windows, we are looking for a semi-automatic welder to join the team. The company is known for its high-quality finishes, attention to detail, and passion for interior design and architecture. Every project is tailor-made — from design to the finished product — with a strong focus on craftsmanship and precision.

Job description:
As a semi-automatic welder, you will help produce steel doors and windows for both interior and exterior applications. You will be responsible for very fine welding work and ensure that every piece meets the highest quality standards.

Your tasks:

• 
Performing fine welding work (semi-automatic)

• 
Filing, grinding, and assembling components

• 
Cleaning and smoothing weld seams

• 
Reading and interpreting technical drawings

• 
Delivering precise, high-quality work

PROFIEL

Profile:

• 
You have experience as a welder or are a motivated school leaver

• 
You can read and understand technical plans

• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English

• 
You enjoy detailed, varied work during day shifts

AANBOD
What’s on offer:
You will join a growing company with a strong reputation in the steel and interior design sector. You’ll work in a modern workshop alongside colleagues who value craftsmanship and quality.

Forklift drivers - 2 shifts - region Desselgem

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

Do you have experience as a forklift driver and a valid forklift certificate?

Are you willing to work in shifts and in a fast-paced production environment?

This internationally growing production company specializes in innovative solutions for the construction and interior sector and is known for its strong focus on quality and sustainability. • Willing to work in shifts

• Attractive salary 
• Stable job in an international company
• Shift allowance (extra pay for shifts) 
• Modern and safe working environment 
• Opportunities for growth and long-term employment

The company is a leading player in waste management, specialising in the sorting, processing and recycling of various waste streams. It continuously invests in new technologies to efficiently separate recyclable materials within a circular economy.
Multiple sites are located across Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do as a Hooklift Truck Driver?
	
• Transport, collect and place roll-off containers at customer locations

Forklift driver - polyvalent job

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

For a company in the Waregem area, I am looking for a polyvalent forklift driver.

• You can speak sufficient English. French is a plus.

• An attractive salary package

Industrial project scope

In this role, you are responsible for delivering complex multidisciplinary engineering projects in an industrial process environment. You oversee the full project lifecycle and take ownership of scope, budget, planning, quality and safety. The assignment covers both greenfield installations and substantial modifications to existing industrial assets.

Key responsibilities

• Lead industrial engineering projects from feasibility and concept definition through commissioning and final transfer to operations.
• Establish and manage project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and the baseline schedule in MS Project.
• Steer all project stages, including pre-study, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, site execution, commissioning and handover.
• Serve as the main point of accountability for stakeholders and management throughout the project.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary internal and external teams across mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS domains.
• Manage changes in scope, project risks, claims and deviations that influence budget or timeline.
• Provide clear reporting on progress, decisions and issues to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You have at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end responsibility for industrial CAPEX projects.
• You also bring at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You have solid experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval processes and the commissioning of industrial installations.
• Experience in the process industry is required.
• You have strong hands-on expertise with MS Project and are used to building and owning project planning, not just monitoring it.
• You work at an academic level and combine strong analytical capabilities with a broad helicopter view.
Non-Technical profile requirements

• You operate independently and take full ownership of your assignments.
• You demonstrate strong leadership and are able to challenge stakeholders and contractors when necessary.
• You communicate confidently with stakeholders at every organisational level.
• You bring natural authority in complex industrial settings.
Methodology / Certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

jobs.occupation: Senior CAPEX Project Manager - Process Industry
jobs.description:
Project overview

As Project Manager, you oversee complex multidisciplinary CAPEX projects in the process industry. You carry full responsibility for scope, budget, planning, quality and safety, covering both greenfield installations and substantial modifications to existing industrial assets.

Primary tasks & responsibilities

• Manage industrial engineering projects from initial concept and feasibility through to commissioning and final transfer to operations.
• Set and control project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and baseline planning in MS Project.
• Coordinate every project stage: pre-study and concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement and contractor selection, construction and on-site execution, commissioning, and operational handover.
• Serve as the main point of accountability for internal stakeholders and management.
• Lead multidisciplinary teams spanning mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS domains, in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
• Handle scope changes, risks, claims and deviations that influence budget or timing.
• Provide structured reporting on progress, issues and decisions to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You have at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• You have at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in fields such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You have demonstrated experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval and commissioning of industrial installations.
• Experience in the process industry is mandatory.
• You have strong hands-on expertise in MS Project and take ownership of project planning rather than only follow-up.
• You combine an academic working level with strong analytical capabilities and a helicopter view.
Non-technical profile requirements

• You work independently and take full ownership of your responsibilities.
• You demonstrate strong leadership and are able to challenge stakeholders and contractors when necessary.
• You communicate clearly and effectively with stakeholders at all organisational levels.
• You bring natural authority in complex industrial settings.
Methodology / certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer Polish - German - English
jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Representative, you will work Monday to Friday in rotating shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

• Answer phone calls and emails from customers and partners.

• Collect and verify information.

• Provide technical support and maintain contact with repair workshops.

• Keep customers and all involved parties informed in a timely manner.

• Follow up on agreements and ensure all information is correctly processed in the customer file.

• You speak and write Polish, German, and English fluently to assist our customers effectively.

• You are comfortable working with computer systems and can multitask.

• You have strong communication skills and can handle phone calls and emails professionally.

• You are solution-oriented and always strive to provide the best support to customers.
